name: top-champions-1-cold
description: Twin of top-champions-1 played at softmax temperature 0.02 (near argmax) instead of 0.1, same calibrations, 100 round-robins (11-11 ~00:45): the dip twins showed the late copy tree's 63-Elo lead over F-L at T 0.1 vanishing at T 0.02, so the standard arena's ranking may depend on how each model's calibration sets its play temperature. Alpha-beta plays argmax, so this is the measurement closer to the goal. The user's arena of 11-11 ~00:20: the old champion league's top 5 champions (cycle 75, by champion Elo at ply 2), the top 5 of the leaf-sources pair arena, and the top 1 of the lr-settings and probit-settings pair arenas, all at ply 2. The old champions are the champion run's model files (cycles/runs/), calibrated as there: 600 own games at depth 1, log-odds softmax T 0.1, seed 5, under the lr held-out set; hybrid9 replays their champion-run own games byte-for-byte (checked 00:20), so the default own-games binary is used.
